£2,000,000,000 Guaranteed Secured Note Programme (the "Programme") established by Bromford Flagship LiveWest Limited

Bromford Flagship LiveWest Limited (the "Issuer") has today published programme admission particulars dated 9 September 2026 in accordance with the rulebook of the International Securities Market and containing details of the Programme and the Issuer (the "Programme Admission Particulars") To view the full document, please paste the following URL into the address bar of your browser

The Issuer, Bromford Flagship LiveWest Limited, has also published its Sustainable Finance Framework (the "Framework"). The Framework has had a Second Party Opinion provided by Moodys. The Framework and the Second Party Opinion are available at www.bfl-places.co.uk/invest-with-us/
Rachael Sivewright, Head of New Funding and Investment
